mapper.sql: select ID, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, url, target, menu_type, visible, is_refresh, ifnull(perms, '') as perms, icon, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME from sys_menu
mapper.select: select distinct m.ID, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.url, m.visible, m.is_refresh, ifnull(m.perms, '') as perms, m.target, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.CREATE_TIME from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.ID = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role ro on ur.role_id = ro.ID where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.visible = 0 AND ro.status = 0 order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select distinct m.ID, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.url, m.visible, m.is_refresh, ifnull(m.perms, '') as perms, m.target, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.CREATE_TIME from sys_menu m where m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.visible = 0 order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select distinct m.ID, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.url, m.visible, m.is_refresh, ifnull(m.perms, '') as perms, m.target, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.CREATE_TIME from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.ID = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role ro on ur.role_id = ro.ID where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.ID = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_role r on r.ID = ur.role_id where m.visible = '0' and r.status = '0' and ur.user_id = #{userId}
select distinct perms from sys_menu where visible = '0' and perms is not null and perms != ''
select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.ID = rm.menu_id where m.visible = '0' and rm.role_id = #{roleId}
select concat(m.ID, ifnull(m.perms, '')) as perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.ID = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id = #{roleId} order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

SELECT t.ID, t.parent_id, t.menu_name, t.order_num, t.url, t.target, t.menu_type, t.visible, t.is_refresh, t.perms, t.icon, t.ATTR1, (SELECT menu_name FROM sys_menu WHERE ID = t.parent_id) parent_name FROM sys_menu t where t.ID = #{id}
mapper.update:

where ID = #{id}
